# Telning Publishing House

> Telning (telning.com) is a small publishing house in Sweden that makes wordless picture books for children aged 0–7. The child colours the story, chooses how it ends (two endings side by side) or draws their own ending, and talks about it with a grown-up. The books are created by the Telning team of cognitive and behavioural scientists. "Telning" is Swedish for a young shoot. It is not the Swedish dictionary word in any other sense on this site.

- TADA is Telning's own way to talk about a story with a child: Talk, Ask, Decide, Act. It is based on dialogic reading and on the team's clinical and behavioural work.
- Pim is the Telning character: a small hedgehog with green leaf spines and three gold stars on its head. Pim speaks for Telning, writes the letters and signs the story cards. Pim is not part of any series.
- A story card: a parent sends a photo of the child's drawn ending; Telning sends back a card with the drawing and two lines from Pim, plus ideas for the next talk. First name and age only, never a photo of a child.
- Legal entity: WelloWork AB, Sweden. Social: Instagram and TikTok @telning.pub, LinkedIn /company/telning.

## Pages

- [Home](https://telning.com/): picture books where your child chooses the ending; twelve series, ages 0–3, 3–5, 5–7.
- [The TADA way](https://telning.com/tada): how TADA was built, the science in plain words with sources, the four steps.
- [For grown-ups](https://telning.com/guide): how to read a Telning book together, questions that work, tips by age, FAQ.
- [Send Pim your ending](https://telning.com/send): send a drawing, get a story card and talk ideas by email.
- [About us](https://telning.com/about): the founder's note, the team, how a book is made, our promises, contact.
- [Meet Pim](https://telning.com/pim): who Pim is.
- [For teachers](https://telning.com/teachers): wordless picture books in the classroom, TADA for groups.
- [Privacy](https://telning.com/privacy), [Children's privacy](https://telning.com/childrens-privacy), [Terms](https://telning.com/terms).
